title: The Mandalorian
description: Din Djarin, known to some simply as "The Mandalorian," was raised by the Mandalorians as a foundling. He accepted the creed and took on the role of bounty hunter to help support the Mandalorian covert he called home. He took a mission to track down an asset for the Empire and instead found a youngling named Grogu. His life would become inextricably linked with the youngling and the pair would go on adventures across the galaxy, eventually becoming father and son.
